name: libero_soup_to_basket
description: Place an alphabet soup can into a basket using the body's libero_pick_place skill. Predicts a fresh receipt from args, runs it, polls the same Job until terminal, and returns the job id with the three terminal fields, throwing when state/goalStatus/stopStatus are not all successful.
requires: Body supports libero_pick_place; ego_state contains the can and the basket with usable ES references.
ensures: Returns { job, state, goalStatus, stopStatus, evidence } with state=succeeded, goalStatus=achieved, stopStatus=confirmed; otherwise throws an Error containing the job result. No automatic retry.

parameters.target: ES reference of the alphabet soup can to pick
parameters.on: ES reference of the basket to place it into
